paragraphs: AI: "Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare" (Reuters) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Can voters learn to stop worrying and love Big AI?" (The Hill).

Political: "‘Medicare for all’ is popular only when you lie about it" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Katie Zacharia, Trump’s New Press Secretary, Is Fired After 5 Days" (The New York Times).

Economic: "No 10 leaves option open to impose Chinese EV tariffs if UK joins EU scheme" (The Guardian) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Warsh Vows to Tame Inflation as A.I. Delivers ‘Shock’ to Economy" (The New York Times).

Financial: "Indonesian Stocks Plunge as MSCI Threatens to Drop Market from Indexes" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Lufthansa’s Final A346 Flight Marks the End of an Aviation Love Story" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "Russia Appears to Step Up Efforts to Influence U.S. Voters" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Trump denies restricting Ukraine’s access to Starlink — despite fingers pointing at White House" (New York Post).
